sources.entry: The Unarchiver - Unarchive many different kinds of archive files. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-unarchiver/id425424353?platform=mac)

summary.name: The Unarchiver
summary.one_liner: A free Mac app for extracting RAR, ZIP, 7z and dozens of other archive and disc image formats.
use_cases: Open RAR files on a Mac
Unzip ZIP archives with non-Latin filenames
Unpack disc images like ISO or BIN
Set an app as default for archive files on macOS
Recover files from old StuffIt or Amiga archives
summary.what_it_does: The Unarchiver extracts files from a wide range of archive formats on macOS, including ZIP (with AES encryption and Zip64), ZIPX, RAR (with encryption and multi-volume), 7z, tar, gzip, bzip2, LZMA/XZ, CAB, MSI, NSIS and self-extracting EXE files. It also handles disc images (ISO, BIN, MDF, NRG, CDI), split .001/.002 files, and many old formats such as StuffIt, DiskDoubler, ARJ, ACE (old versions only), and Amiga ADF/DMS. Archives with non-Latin filenames are supported. The page says it can be set as the default app for archive files via Get Info > Open with > Change all.
notable: Supports dozens of archive formats beyond the native macOS utility
Handles non-Latin characters in archive names
Includes legacy and Amiga-specific formats via libxad
caveats: Requires macOS 10.13 or later; earlier versions need the separate download linked on the page
Some formats only partially supported, e.g. StuffIt X JPEG compression, ARJ multi-part, Ace 2.0+ not supported
Encryption for some old formats (ARC/PAK) only works in command-line utilities
